MANDARIN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #15
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How does the voice move in the fourth tone? (1 mark)
   A. It stays flat
   B. It falls sharply
   C. It rises
   D. It dips and rises

2. What is a good strategy to speak Chinese clearly? (1 mark)
   A. Whisper all the time
   B. Speak as fast as possible
   C. Listen first and copy the tone with your hand
   D. Ignore the tones

3. Which Chinese word means "where"? (1 mark)
   A. 门 mén
   B. 哪儿 nǎr
   C. 旁边 pángbiān
   D. 卧室 wòshì

4. What does 九 (jiǔ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Four
   B. Two
   C. Nine
   D. Eight

5. What does 星期一到星期五,我上学 mean? (1 mark)
   A. On Sunday, I rest at home
   B. I go to school on Saturday
   C. Monday is a holiday
   D. From Monday to Friday, I go to school

6. What does 他们 (tāmen) mean? (1 mark)
   A. We
   B. To wish
   C. Cup
   D. They

7. What does 切 (qiē) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To wish
   B. They
   C. Friend
   D. To cut

8. What does 来 (lái) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To come
   B. Cup
   C. Birthday
   D. Friend

9. What does 苹果 (píngguǒ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Meat
   B. Chicken (meat)
   C. Apple
   D. Drinks

10. What does 咖啡 (kāfēi) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Lunch
   B. To eat
   C. Coffee
   D. Dinner

11. "I am in the middle of your face and help you breathe." Which word is the answer? (1 mark)
   A. 嘴巴 zuǐba
   B. 鼻子 bízi
   C. 脚 jiǎo
   D. 头 tóu

12. Fill the blank: 我用耳朵____。 (I use my ears to hear.) (1 mark)
   A. 看
   B. 说
   C. 听
   D. 吃

13. Which sentence means "Today there are clouds."? (1 mark)
   A. 今天有云。
   B. 今天天气很好。
   C. 今天下雨。
   D. 雨很大。

14. Which sentence means "Goodbye!"? (1 mark)
   A. 我叫小明。
   B. 再见!
   C. 你呢?
   D. 谢谢!

15. What is intonation? (1 mark)
   A. The number of strokes
   B. The spelling of a word
   C. How the voice rises and falls
   D. The size of a character

16. Which sentence means "On Sunday, go to church."? (1 mark)
   A. 我星期六在家休息。
   B. 明天是星期四。
   C. 星期天,去教堂。
   D. 今天星期三。

17. What is vocal projection? (1 mark)
   A. Reading very fast
   B. Reading without tones
   C. Sending your voice to the back of the room without shouting
   D. Reading in a whisper

18. What does 十 (shí) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Three
   B. Nine
   C. Ten
   D. Two

19. What does 朋友 (péngyou) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Date (day of the month)
   B. Month
   C. Friend
   D. To wish

20. Which sentence means "When is your birthday?"? (1 mark)
   A. 我们唱歌。
   B. 我们切蛋糕。
   C. 你生日是几月几号?
   D. 朋友送我礼物。

21. What does 大家 (dàjiā) mean? (1 mark)
   A. They
   B. Everybody
   C. We
   D. Month

22. What does 鸡肉 (jīròu) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Grapes
   B. Fruit (as a group)
   C. Chicken (meat)
   D. Apple

23. What is skimming? (1 mark)
   A. Looking for one word
   B. Writing a text
   C. Reading quickly to get the general idea
   D. Copying a text

24. Fill the blank: 今天____雨。 (Today it rains.) (1 mark)
   A. 在
   B. 好
   C. 下
   D. 上

25. How many strokes does the character 十 have? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 3
   C. 2
   D. 1

26. What does 妈妈 (māma) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Younger sister
   B. Father
   C. Younger brother
   D. Mother

27. Which sentence means "There are five people in my family."? (1 mark)
   A. 我爱你。
   B. 这是我姐姐。
   C. 那是我哥哥。
   D. 我家有五口人。

28. How is 冰箱 written in pinyin? (1 mark)
   A. bìngxiàng
   B. bingxiang
   C. bīngxiāng
   D. bǐngxiāng

29. Which Chinese word means "seven"? (1 mark)
   A. 四 sì
   B. 十 shí
   C. 六 liù
   D. 七 qī

30. Fill the blank: 我星期三____学校。 (On Wednesday I go to school.) (1 mark)
   A. 有
   B. 是
   C. 去
   D. 吃

31. Read the pinyin: xīngqītiān, qù jiàotáng. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. On Friday, go to the mosque.
   B. On Saturday I rest at home.
   C. On Wednesday I go to school.
   D. On Sunday, go to church.

32. What does 茶 (chá) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Tea
   B. Flat bread
   C. Dinner
   D. Beef

33. What does 吃 (chī) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Beef
   B. To like
   C. To eat
   D. Lunch

34. Which word is pronounced xǐshǒu? (1 mark)
   A. 洗手
   B. 肩膀
   C. 头
   D. 说

35. Which sentence means "I use my ears to hear."? (1 mark)
   A. 我用耳朵听。
   B. 我有两只眼睛。
   C. 我用眼睛看。
   D. 我用嘴巴说。

36. Which Chinese word means "rain"? (1 mark)
   A. 天气 tiānqì
   B. 刮风 guā fēng
   C. 没有 méiyǒu
   D. 雨 yǔ

37. Which Chinese word means "sun"? (1 mark)
   A. 太阳 tàiyáng
   B. 也 yě
   C. 小 xiǎo
   D. 天气 tiānqì

38. Fill in the blank: 浴室在花园____。 (beside) (1 mark)
   A. 左边
   B. 上面
   C. 旁边
   D. 下面

39. Which sentence means "The window is above the sofa."? (1 mark)
   A. 沙发在门旁边。
   B. 冰箱在厨房。
   C. 电视在哪儿?
   D. 窗户在沙发上面。

40. Fill the blank: 花园在房子____。 (The garden is on the right of the house.) (1 mark)
   A. 里
   B. 左边
   C. 下面
   D. 右边

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "This is my older sister." (2 marks)

42. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The bed is in the bedroom." (2 marks)

43. Describe how to work out the meaning of an unknown word in a sentence. (3 marks)

44. Write the question for "Who is this?" and answer it with "This is my father", with pinyin. (2 marks)

45. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 下雨 and 耳朵. (2 marks)

46. Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "What is this?" and "This is a banana." (4 marks)

47. Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The wind is very strong." and "Today it rains." (4 marks)

48. Write a short conversation of three lines in which two learners greet each other, give their names and ask "And you?". Include pinyin. (5 marks)

49. Write a short paragraph in Chinese with pinyin that says there are four people in your family and names three of them. (5 marks)

50. Rearrange and translate: 浴室 / 花园 / 旁边 / 在. (3 marks)

51. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 刷牙, 手 and 生日. (3 marks)

52. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I like to drink tea." (2 marks)

53. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 谢谢, 哭 and 星期三. (3 marks)

54. Read the rhyme 妈妈骑马,马慢,妈妈骂马 and explain how the tone changes meaning. (4 marks)

55. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 小 and 哥哥. (2 marks)

56. What is the main idea of a text and what are details? Give a short example. (3 marks)

57. What is the job of 吗 in a sentence? Give an example. (2 marks)

58. Write in Chinese with pinyin: "I like to drink tea." (2 marks)

59. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Today there are clouds." (2 marks)

60. Answer the riddle in Chinese with pinyin: "I help you hear. I am on the sides of your head." (2 marks)

61. Write two sentences about your family with 这是, and give pinyin. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #15 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — It falls sharply
   The fourth tone falls quickly from high to low.

2. C — Listen first and copy the tone with your hand
   Listening and copying the tone shapes helps you speak clearly.

3. B — 哪儿 nǎr
   哪儿 (nǎr) means where.

4. C — Nine
   九 (jiǔ) means nine.

5. D — From Monday to Friday, I go to school
   到 is to, and 上学 is go to school.

6. D — They
   他们 (tāmen) means they.

7. D — To cut
   切 (qiē) means to cut.

8. A — To come
   来 (lái) means to come.

9. C — Apple
   苹果 (píngguǒ) means apple.

10. C — Coffee
   咖啡 (kāfēi) means coffee.

11. B — 鼻子 bízi
   The nose is in the middle of the face.

12. C — 听
   听 is to hear.

13. A — 今天有云。
   今天有云。 (jīntiān yǒu yún.) means "Today there are clouds.".

14. B — 再见!
   再见! (zàijiàn!) means "Goodbye!".

15. C — How the voice rises and falls
   Intonation is the rise and fall of the voice.

16. C — 星期天,去教堂。
   星期天,去教堂。 (xīngqītiān, qù jiàotáng.) means "On Sunday, go to church.".

17. C — Sending your voice to the back of the room without shouting
   Good breathing and an open mouth help you project.

18. C — Ten
   十 (shí) means ten.

19. C — Friend
   朋友 (péngyou) means friend.

20. C — 你生日是几月几号?
   你生日是几月几号? (nǐ shēngrì shì jǐ yuè jǐ hào?) means "When is your birthday?".

21. B — Everybody
   大家 (dàjiā) means everybody.

22. C — Chicken (meat)
   鸡肉 (jīròu) means chicken (meat).

23. C — Reading quickly to get the general idea
   Skimming gives you the main idea.

24. C — 下
   下雨 means it rains.

25. C — 2
   十 has 横 and 竖.

26. D — Mother
   妈妈 (māma) means mother.

27. D — 我家有五口人。
   我家有五口人。 (wǒ jiā yǒu wǔ kǒu rén.) means "There are five people in my family.".

28. C — bīngxiāng
   Both syllables have the first tone.

29. D — 七 qī
   七 (qī) means seven.

30. C — 去
   去 means to go.

31. D — On Sunday, go to church.
   xīngqītiān, qù jiàotáng. is 星期天,去教堂。, which means "On Sunday, go to church.".

32. A — Tea
   茶 (chá) means tea.

33. C — To eat
   吃 (chī) means to eat.

34. A — 洗手
   洗手 is pronounced xǐshǒu and means to wash hands.

35. A — 我用耳朵听。
   我用耳朵听。 (wǒ yòng ěrduo tīng.) means "I use my ears to hear.".

36. D — 雨 yǔ
   雨 (yǔ) means rain.

37. A — 太阳 tàiyáng
   太阳 (tàiyáng) means sun.

38. C — 旁边
   旁边 is beside.

39. D — 窗户在沙发上面。
   窗户在沙发上面。 (chuānghu zài shāfā shàngmiàn.) means "The window is above the sofa.".

40. D — 右边
   右边 is the right side.

SECTION B
----
41. (2 marks)
   Answer: 这是我姐姐。 zhè shì wǒ jiějie.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: 床在卧室。 chuáng zài wòshì.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: Read the whole sentence, look at the words you know, look at pictures, then guess and check with a friend or dictionary.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of three steps.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: 这是谁? zhè shì shéi? 这是我爸爸。 zhè shì wǒ bàba.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the question and 1 mark for the answer.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: 下雨: xià yǔ, it rains. 耳朵: ěrduo, ear.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

46. (4 marks)
   Answer: 这是什么? zhè shì shénme? 这是香蕉。 zhè shì xiāngjiāo.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

47. (4 marks)
   Answer: 风很大。 fēng hěn dà. 今天下雨。 jīntiān xià yǔ.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

48. (5 marks)
   Answer: A: 你好! nǐ hǎo! B: 你好!我叫安娜。你呢? nǐ hǎo! wǒ jiào Ānnà. nǐ ne? A: 我叫小明。 wǒ jiào Xiǎomíng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct greeting line and 1 mark each for the name sentences, 1 mark for correct pinyin tone marks, 5 in total.

49. (5 marks)
   Answer: 我家有四口人。这是我爸爸,这是我妈妈,这是我。 wǒ jiā yǒu sì kǒu rén. zhè shì wǒ bàba, zhè shì wǒ māma, zhè shì wǒ.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the family size sentence, 2 marks for three correct sentences, 1 mark for pinyin, 1 mark for punctuation.

50. (3 marks)
   Answer: 浴室在花园旁边。 The bathroom is beside the garden.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the order, 1 mark for 。, 1 mark for the meaning.

51. (3 marks)
   Answer: 刷牙: shuāyá, to brush teeth. 手: shǒu, hand. 生日: shēngrì, birthday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

52. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我喜欢喝茶。 wǒ xǐhuan hē chá.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

53. (3 marks)
   Answer: 谢谢: xièxie, thank you. 哭: kū, to cry. 星期三: xīngqīsān, Wednesday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

54. (4 marks)
   Answer: Māma qí mǎ, mǎ màn, māma mà mǎ. Mum rides a horse, the horse is slow, mum scolds the horse. The syllable ma changes meaning with the tone: mā mother, mǎ horse, mà scold.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the pinyin, 1 mark for the meaning, 2 marks for explaining the three ma words.

55. (2 marks)
   Answer: 小: xiǎo, small. 哥哥: gēge, older brother.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

56. (3 marks)
   Answer: The main idea is what the whole text is about, for example "my home". Details are facts that support it, for example "there is a sofa in the living room".
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for main idea, 1 mark for details, 1 mark for the example.

57. (2 marks)
   Answer: 吗 makes a yes-or-no question, for example 电视在桌子上吗?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the job and 1 mark for the example.

58. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我喜欢喝茶。 wǒ xǐhuan hē chá.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin.

59. (2 marks)
   Answer: 今天有云。 jīntiān yǒu yún.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

60. (2 marks)
   Answer: 耳朵 ěrduo (ears).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the word and 1 mark for the pinyin.

61. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example 这是我爸爸。 zhè shì wǒ bàba. 这是我妈妈。 zhè shì wǒ māma.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence, 1 mark for correct pinyin.
